rules.title: App Router
rules.text: Use the App Router; keep components server components by default.

rules.title: Minimize client components
rules.text: Add "use client" only to the smallest components that need interactivity or browser APIs.

rules.title: Fetch on the server
rules.text: Fetch data in server components or route handlers, not in client effects.

rules.title: Env var exposure
rules.text: Expose only NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables to the browser and never put secrets in them.

rules.title: next/image and next/font
rules.text: Use next/image and next/font for images and fonts.
